openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: C2M API v2
  version: 2.0.0
  description: API for submitting mailing jobs with various document routing options
  x-http-error-map:
    '400':
      errorType: ValidationError
      errorCodes:
      - MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD
      - INVALID_ONEOF
      - INVALID_JSON
    '401':
      errorType: AuthenticationError
      errorCodes:
      - MISSING_AUTH_HEADER
      - INVALID_TOKEN
      - EXPIRED_TOKEN
    '403':
      errorType: AuthorizationError
      errorCodes:
      - INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS
      - ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED
    '404':
      errorType: ResourceNotFoundError
      errorCodes:
      - JOB_NOT_FOUND
      - RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
    '422':
      errorType: ValidationError
      errorCodes:
      - INVALID_ENUM_VALUE
      - MUTUAL_EXCLUSION_VIOLATION
      - INVALID_FORMAT
    '500':
      errorType: ServerError
      errorCodes:
      - SERVER_ERROR
      - DATABASE_ERROR
      - EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR
servers:
- url: https://api.click2mail.com/v2
  description: Production server
tags:
- name: jobs
  description: Job submission endpoints
- name: auth
  description: Authentication and token management endpoints
components:
  schemas:
    month:
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      maximum: 12
    submitSingleDocParams:
      type: object
      properties:
        jobTemplate:
          type: string
        docSourceAll:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/docSourceAll'
        recipientAddressSource:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/recipientAddressSource'
        paymentDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/paymentDetails'
        returnAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/returnAddress'
        jobOptions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/jobOptions'
        tags:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/tags'
      required:
      - docSourceAll
      - recipientAddressSource
    submitSinglePdfAddressCaptureParams:
      type: object
      properties:
        jobTemplate:
          type: string
        docSourceStandard:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/docSourceStandard'
        paymentDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/paymentDetails'
        returnAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/returnAddress'
        jobOptions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/jobOptions'
        tags:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/tags'
      required:
      - docSourceStandard
    submitSinglePdfSplitParams:
      type: object
      properties:
        jobTemplate:
          type: string
        docSourceStandard:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/docSourceStandard'
        pdfSplitJobsWithAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/pdfSplitJobsWithAddress'
        paymentDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/paymentDetails'
        returnAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/returnAddress'
        jobOptions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/jobOptions'
        tags:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/tags'

      - docSourceStandard
      - pdfSplitJobsWithAddress
    submitSinglePdfSplitAddressCaptureParams:

          type: string
        docSourceStandard:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/docSourceStandard'
        pdfSplitJobsNoAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/pdfSplitJobsNoAddress'
        paymentDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/paymentDetails'
        returnAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/returnAddress'
        jobOptions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/jobOptions'
        tags:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/tags'
      required:
      - docSourceStandard
      - pdfSplitJobsNoAddress
    submitMultiDocParams:
      type: object
      properties:
        multiDocJobs:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/multiDocJobs'
        paymentDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/paymentDetails'
        tags:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/tags'
      required:
      - multiDocJobs
    submitMultiDocMergeParams:
      type: object
      properties:
        jobTemplate:
          type: string
        mergeDocumentSource:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/mergeDocumentSource'
        recipientAddressSource:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/recipientAddressSource'
        paymentDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/paymentDetails'
        returnAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/returnAddress'
        jobOptions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/jobOptions'
        tags:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/tags'
      required:
      - mergeDocumentSource
      - recipientAddressSource
    submitMultiZipParams:
      type: object
      properties:
        docSourceZipFileRef:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/docSourceZipFileRef'
        multiZipJobs:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/multiZipJobs'
        paymentDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/paymentDetails'
        tags:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/tags'
      required:
      - docSourceZipFileRef
      - multiZipJobs
    submitMultiZipAddressCaptureParams:
      type: object
      properties:
        jobTemplate:
          type: string
        zipDocumentSource:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/zipDocumentSource'
        paymentDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/paymentDetails'
        returnAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/returnAddress'
        jobOptions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/jobOptions'
        tags:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/tags'
      required:
      - zipDocumentSource
    jobTemplate:
      type: string
    returnAddress:

      properties:
        firstName:
          type: string
        lastName:
          type: string
        company:
          type: string
        address1:
          type: string
        city:
          type: string
        state:
          type: string
        zip:
          type: string
        country:
          type: string
        address2:
          type: string
        address3:
          type: string
      required:
      - firstName
      - lastName
      - address1
      - city
      - state
      - zip
      - country
    jobOptions:
      type: object
      properties:
        documentClass:
          type: string
        layout:
          type: string
        productionTime:
          type: string
        envelope:
          type: string
        color:
          type: string
        paperType:
          type: string
        printOption:
          type: string
        mailClass:
          type: string
      required:
      - documentClass
      - layout
      - productionTime
      - envelope
      - color
      - paperType
      - printOption
      - mailClass
    documentClass:

    layout:
      type: string
    productionTime:
      type: string
    envelope:
      type: string
    color:
      type: string
    paperType:
      type: string
    printOption:
      type: string
    mailClass:
      type: string
    tags:

    tagsList:

    firstName:

    lastName:
      type: string
    address1:
      type: string
    address2:
      type: string
    address3:
      type: string
    city:
      type: string
    state:
      type: string
    zip:
      type: string
    country:
      type: string
    foo1:
      type: string
    foo2:
      type: string
    address:
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          type: string
        lastName:
          type: string
        address1:
          type: string
        city:
          type: string
        state:
          type: string
        zip:
          type: string
        country:
          type: string
        address2:
          type: string
        address3:
          type: string
        foo1:
          type: string
        foo2:
          type: string
      required:
      - firstName
      - lastName
      - address1
      - city
      - state
      - zip
      - country
    recipientAddressSource:

      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/recipientAddressByList'

      type: object

    recipientAddressByList:

    recipientAddressByListId:

    recipientAddressByAddressId:

    mappingId:

    addressName:
      type: string
    addressListName:
      type: string
    addressListId:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/id'
    addressId:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/id'
    singleAddress:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/address'
    addressList:
      type: array
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/address'
    documentIdSource:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/documentId'
    documentId:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/id'
    requestIdSource:
      type: object
      properties:
        requestId:
          type: integer
        filename:
          type: string
      required:
      - requestId
    requestId:

    filename:
      type: string
    urlSource:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/url'
    url:
      type: string
    zipDocumentIdSource:
      type: object
      properties:
        zipDocumentId:
          type: integer
        filename:
          type: string
      required:
      - zipDocumentId
      - filename
    zipDocumentId:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/id'
    zipRequestIdSource:
      type: object
      properties:
        requestId:
          type: integer
        zipFilename:
          type: string
        filename:
          type: string
      required:
      - requestId
      - zipFilename
      - filename
    zipFilename:
      type: string
    zipDocumentIdOnly:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/zipDocumentId'
    zipRequestIdOnly:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/requestId'
    zipDocumentSource:
      oneOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/zipDocumentIdSource'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/zipRequestIdSource'
    docSourceStandard:
      oneOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/documentIdSource'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/requestIdSource'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/urlSource'
    docSourceZipFile:
      oneOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/zipDocumentIdSource'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/zipRequestIdSource'
    docSourceZipFileRef:
      oneOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/zipDocumentIdOnly'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/zipRequestIdOnly'
    docSourceAll:
      oneOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/docSourceStandard'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/docSourceZipFile'
    mergeDocumentSource:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/documentsToMerge'
    documentsToMerge:
      type: array
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/mergeDocumentRef'
    mergeDocumentRef:
      oneOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/mergeByDocumentId'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/mergeByRequestId'
    mergeByDocumentId:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/documentId'
    mergeByRequestId:
      type: object
      properties:
        requestId:
          type: integer
        filename:
          type: string
      required:
      - requestId
    multiDocJobs:
      type: array
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/multiDocJobItem'
    multiDocJobItem:
      type: object
      properties:
        jobTemplate:
          type: string
        docSourceAll:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/docSourceAll'
        recipientAddressSource:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/recipientAddressSource'
      required:
      - docSourceAll
      - recipientAddressSource
    pdfSplitJobsWithAddress:
      type: array
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/pdfSplitJobItemWithAddress'
    pdfSplitJobsNoAddress:
      type: array
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/pdfSplitJobItemNoAddress'
    pdfSplitJobItemWithAddress:
      type: object
      properties:
        jobTemplate:
          type: string
        startPage:
          type: integer
        endPage:
          type: integer
        recipientAddressSource:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/recipientAddressSource'
      required:
      - startPage
      - endPage
      - recipientAddressSource
    pdfSplitJobItemNoAddress:
      type: object
      properties:
        startPage:
          type: integer
        endPage:
          type: integer
      required:
      - startPage
      - endPage
    startPage:
      type: integer
    endPage:
      type: integer
    multiZipJobs:
      type: array
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/multiZipJobItem'
    multiZipJobItem:
      type: object
      properties:
        jobTemplate:
          type: string
        filename:
          type: string
        recipientAddressSource:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/recipientAddressSource'
      required:
      - filename
      - recipientAddressSource
    id:
      type: integer
    paymentDetails:
      oneOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/creditCardPayment'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/invoicePayment'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/achPayment'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/userCreditPayment'
    creditCardPayment:
      type: object
      properties:
        creditCardDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/creditCardDetails'
      required:
      - creditCardDetails
    invoicePayment:
      type: object
      properties:
        invoiceDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/invoiceDetails'
      required:
      - invoiceDetails
    achPayment:
      type: object
      properties:
        achDetails:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/achDetails'
      required:
      - achDetails
    userCreditPayment:
      type: object
      properties:
        creditAmount:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/creditAmount'
      required:
      - creditAmount
    creditCardDetails:
      type: object
      properties:
        cardType:
          type: string
          enum:
          - visa
          - mastercard
          - discover
          - americanExpress
        cardNumber:
          type: string
        expirationDate:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/expirationDate'
        cvv:
          type: integer
      required:
      - cardType
      - cardNumber
      - expirationDate
      - cvv
    invoiceDetails:
      type: object
      properties:
        invoiceNumber:
          type: string
        amountDue:
          type: number
      required:
      - invoiceNumber
      - amountDue
    achDetails:
      type: object
      properties:
        routingNumber:
          type: string
        accountNumber:
          type: string
        checkDigit:
          type: integer
      required:
      - routingNumber
      - accountNumber
      - checkDigit
    creditAmount:
      type: object
      properties:
        amount:
          type: number
        currency:
          type: string
          enum:
          - USD
          - EUR
          - GBP
          - CAD
          - AUD
      required:
      - amount
      - currency
    currency:
      type: string
      enum:
      - USD
      - EUR
      - GBP
      - CAD
      - AUD
    amount:
      type: number
    cardNumber:
      type: string
    expirationDate:
      type: object
      properties:
        month:
          type: integer
        year:
          type: integer
      required:
      - month
      - year
    year:
      type: integer
    cvv:
      type: integer
    routingNumber:
      type: string
    accountNumber:
      type: string
    checkDigit:
      type: integer
    invoiceNumber:
      type: string
    amountDue:
      type: number
    cardType:
      type: string
      enum:
      - visa
      - mastercard
      - discover
      - americanExpress
    standardResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
        message:
          type: string
        requestId:
          type: integer
      required:
      - status
      - message
      - requestId
    status:
      type: string
    message:
      type: string
    errorResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        errorType:
          type: string
          enum:
          - ValidationError
          - AuthenticationError
          - AuthorizationError
          - ResourceNotFoundError
          - ServerError
        errorMessage:
          type: string
        errorCode:
          type: string
          enum:
          - MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD
          - INVALID_ONEOF
          - INVALID_JSON
          - MISSING_AUTH_HEADER
          - INVALID_TOKEN
          - EXPIRED_TOKEN
          - INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS
          - ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED
          - JOB_NOT_FOUND
          - RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
          - INVALID_ENUM_VALUE
          - MUTUAL_EXCLUSION_VIOLATION
          - INVALID_FORMAT
          - SERVER_ERROR
          - DATABASE_ERROR
          - EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR
        errorDetails:
          type: string
        errorTrackingId:
          type: string
      required:
      - errorType
      - errorMessage
      - errorCode
    errorType:
      type: string
      enum:
      - ValidationError
      - AuthenticationError
      - AuthorizationError
      - ResourceNotFoundError
      - ServerError
    errorMessage:
      type: string
    errorCode:
      type: string
      enum:
      - MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD
      - INVALID_ONEOF
      - INVALID_JSON
      - MISSING_AUTH_HEADER
      - INVALID_TOKEN
      - EXPIRED_TOKEN
      - INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS
      - ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED
      - JOB_NOT_FOUND
      - RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
      - INVALID_ENUM_VALUE
      - MUTUAL_EXCLUSION_VIOLATION
      - INVALID_FORMAT
      - SERVER_ERROR
      - DATABASE_ERROR
      - EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR
    errorDetails:
      type: string
    errorTrackingId:
      type: string
    HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/errorResponse'
    HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/errorResponse'
    HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/errorResponse'
    HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/errorResponse'
    HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/errorResponse'
    HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/errorResponse'
    ShortTokenRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        long_token:
          type: string
          description: Optional if the long-term token is provided in Authorization header
        scopes:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Optional scope narrowing; defaults to the long-term token's scopes
      additionalProperties: false
    ShortTokenResponse:
      type: object
      required:
      - token_type
      - access_token
      - expires_in
      - expires_at
      properties:
        token_type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - Bearer
        access_token:
          type: string
          description: Short-lived JWT
        expires_in:
          type: integer
          description: Lifetime in seconds (e.g., 900 for 15 minutes)
        expires_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: ISO 8601 timestamp of expiration
        scopes:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Granted scopes
        token_id:
          type: string
          description: Server-issued identifier for this token
    LongTokenRequest:
      type: object
      description: One of several credential mechanisms must be provided.
      required:
      - grant_type
      - client_id
      properties:
        grant_type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - client_credentials
          - assertion
          description: The authentication grant type
        client_id:
          type: string
          description: Client identifier issued by Click2Mail
        client_secret:
          type: string
          description: Required if using client_credentials with secret
        otp_code:
          type: string
          description: Required if your policy mandates OTP for issuance
        assertion_type:
          type: string
          description: Required when grant_type=assertion
        assertion:
          type: string
          description: Signed JWT or other accepted assertion
        scopes:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Scopes to assign to the long-term token
        ttl_seconds:
          type: integer
          minimum: 3600
          maximum: 7776000
          description: Requested lifetime (1 hour - 90 days). Server may clamp.
      additionalProperties: false
    LongTokenResponse:
      type: object
      required:
      - token_type
      - access_token
      - expires_in
      - expires_at
      properties:
        token_type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - Bearer
        access_token:
          type: string
          description: Long-lived token (opaque or JWT depending on deployment)
        expires_in:
          type: integer
          description: Lifetime in seconds
        expires_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: ISO 8601 timestamp of expiration
        scopes:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Granted scopes
        token_id:
          type: string
          description: Server-issued identifier for this token
    AuthError:
      type: object
      required:
      - code
      - message
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          example: invalid_grant
          description: OAuth-style error code
        message:
          type: string
          example: The provided client credentials are invalid.
          description: Human-readable error message
        details:
          type: object
          description: Additional error details
  parameters:
    Authorization:
      name: Authorization
      in: header
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        example: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
    Content-Type:
      name: Content-Type
      in: header
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        example: application/json
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
    LongTokenAuth:
      type: oauth2
      description: Long-term JWT for exchanging to short-term tokens
      flows:
        clientCredentials:
          tokenUrl: /auth/tokens/long
          scopes:
            tokens:write: Create new long-term tokens
            tokens:revoke: Revoke existing tokens
    ShortTokenAuth:
      type: oauth2
      description: Short-term JWT for API operations
      flows:
        clientCredentials:
          tokenUrl: /auth/tokens/short
          scopes:
            tokens:write: Create new long-term tokens
            tokens:revoke: Revoke existing tokens
    ClientKey:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Client-Id
      description: Client identifier for additional security
  responses:
    Error400:
      description: Bad request
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthError'
          examples:
            invalidGrant:
              value:
                code: invalid_grant
                message: The grant type is not supported
    Error401:
      description: Unauthorized
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthError'
          examples:
            invalidToken:
              value:
                code: invalid_token
                message: The provided token is expired or invalid
    Error403:
      description: Forbidden
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthError'
          examples:
            insufficientScope:
              value:
                code: insufficient_scope
                message: The token lacks the required scope for this operation
    Error404:
      description: Not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthError'
          examples:
            notFound:
              value:
                code: not_found
                message: The requested resource was not found
    Error429:
      description: Too Many Requests
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthError'
          examples:
            rateLimited:
              value:
                code: rate_limited
                message: Too many requests. Please retry after 60 seconds.
security:
- bearerAuth: []
paths:
  /static:
    post:
      tags:
      - jobs
      summary: Submitsingledocparams
      description: API endpoint for submitSingleDocParams
      operationId: submitSingleDocParams
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/submitSingleDocParams'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/standardResponse'
        '400':
          description: Bad Request - Invalid request parameters
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/errorResponse'
              examples:
                example-1:
                  value:
                    errorType: ValidationError
                    errorMessage: Missing required field in request
                    errorCode: MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD
                    errorDetails: '{"field": "docSourceAll", "location": "requestBody"}'
                    errorTrackingId: TRK-20260910-WPWTFR
                example-2:
                  value:
                    errorType: ValidationError
                    errorMessage: Invalid oneOf field value
